electric.method: JCP&L average price 18.39 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 259 kWh/month (3112 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, 1 bedroom, weighted mean, n=165. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=119; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

cooking_only.method: New Jersey Natural Gas, Residential Non-Heating: customer charge $12.00 plus $1.5431 per therm (delivery 1.1414 + BGSS supply 0.4017), from Exhibit A of the BPU order (rates effective 2026-10-01); assumed cooking use 1.6 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=108). Taxes not included.

cooking_plus_heat.method: cooking-only figure ($14) + NJ average residential gas price $1.369/therm (EIA 2025 annual, $14.21/Mcf at 1038 Btu per cubic foot) x 11.7 therms/month of space heating (annual use / 12; RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings heated with gas, n=124). An annual average: winter bills are several times higher and summer bills lower. Water heating is not included.

if_gas_water_heater_add.note: only if the unit has its own gas water heater; RECS 2020, n=128. Not added to the amount.

notes: gas utility from point-in-polygon on the HIFLD Natural Gas Service Territories layer (2016-17 vintage)
whether heat is included is unknown: the cooking-only figure is shown; heat may be extra (see cooking_plus_heat)
assumes the unit has a gas stove; an all-electric unit has no gas bill

total.method: sum of the electric, gas and internet amounts above (lines that are not_found count as 0)

electric.method: JCP&L average price 18.39 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 219 kWh/month (2631 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, studio, weighted mean, n=18; small sample. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=18; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

cooking_only.method: New Jersey Natural Gas, Residential Non-Heating: customer charge $12.00 plus $1.5431 per therm (delivery 1.1414 + BGSS supply 0.4017), from Exhibit A of the BPU order (rates effective 2026-10-01); assumed cooking use 1.4 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=13). Taxes not included.

cooking_plus_heat.method: cooking-only figure ($14) + NJ average residential gas price $1.369/therm (EIA 2025 annual, $14.21/Mcf at 1038 Btu per cubic foot) x 8.3 therms/month of space heating (annual use / 12; RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings heated with gas, n=14). An annual average: winter bills are several times higher and summer bills lower. Water heating is not included.

if_gas_water_heater_add.note: only if the unit has its own gas water heater; RECS 2020, n=17. Not added to the amount.
